description: This file declares an interface IWarningReportingMedia for warning reporting media within the WPEFramework's WarningReporting namespace. It defines a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method Output for reporting warnings, and includes licensing information.

classes.name: IWarningReportingMedia
classes.description: An interface for warning reporting media with a method to output warning information.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs warning information including filename, line number, identifier, and warning event details.
